Bliv kvar hos mig, se, dagens slut är när.
0:00 / —
SV EN FR AR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

Abide with me; behold, the day’s close is nigh. Abide, O Lord, soon night is here. When all else fails and deceives, Thou only faithful Comforter, abide!

2.

As dreams flee, so hasten our years. All earth’s joy like a breath passes away. All hurries on to its transformation soon. Thou art the same, abide Thou with me!

3.

Not merely a glance, a word I ask, Nay, as to Emmaus Thou didst of old come And bore the heavy burden of sorrowing brethren, Come, not to visit only, abide with me!

4.

Thou alone canst subdue the threat of darkness And give strength to stand against the tempter. Each moment I have need of Thy presence; In cold, in sun abide, Lord, with me!

5.

As an infant I was laid in Thy love’s bosom And was blessed in Thy precious name. Thou hast not left me, though on paths of error I often failed Thee. O, abide with me!

6.

I fear not, when Thou art near in grace; Then pain departs, counsel is never lacking, Of the grave’s terror not a trace remains, And death has lost its sting, when I have Thee.

7.

Thy cross shall shine before my gaze, when last I fall asleep, O Lord Jesus Christ. Then night departs, morning breaks clear. In life, in death abide, Lord, with me!

Text: Efter Abide with me av Henry F. Lyte, 1847. Övers. Carl O. Mannströms, 1920. Musik: Eventide av William H. Monk, 1861. 10.10.10.10
